events.title: 🌊 River Drift Is Part of Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: 🌊 River Drift Is Part of Steam Next Fest!Hello, Drifters! 🛶I'm excited to announce that River Drift is participating in Steam Next Fest, and the demo is available to play right now!Grab a friend, hop on a raft, and get ready for a chaotic co-op adventure through dangerous rivers, mysterious forests, and deadly swamps!🐊 Survive dangerous wildlife and unpredictable obstacles.🛶 Paddle together to navigate the river and keep your raft under control.🔥 Repair your raft and survive unexpected disasters

events.title: Paddle Controls Improved + Steam Join Game 🛶
events.summary: You can now hold the paddle key to keep paddling without having to repeatedly press the button, making longer runs more comfortable and reducing fatigue.If you prefer the original playstyle, you can still spam the paddle key to paddle faster and maintain the same fast-paced gameplay as before!You can now join your friends directly from your Steam Friends List!

events.title: River Drift fake website!!!
events.summary: Hello everyone! Someone has created a fake website for my game and unfortunately, it looks pretty convincing. The problem is that the download button links to a virus. This website is not affiliated with me, and you should NOT download River Drift from it. Please only play River Drift through Steam and use the official Steam page to download the game. Stay safe!

events.title: River Drift Launch Update
events.summary: I'm moving River Drift's launch to January 2027.The game will be part of Steam Next Fest this October, where I'll be releasing a demo. I want to take the time to listen to player feedback, polish the experience, and make meaningful improvements before launch.Thank you all for your continued support and feedback!
